hooks.name: turn-end-test-and-pagemap
hooks.description: When the agent finishes a turn, run tests and remind it to keep the README page map in sync with src/pages.

action.prompt: Before finishing: run `npm test`. If any page number was added or removed under src/pages, update the Page map table in README.md (English and Arabic titles) so it matches. Follow .kiro/steering/teletext-rules.md and bilingual.md.
